footer.tagline: Small-group journeys through Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos.

home.heroTitle: Follow the river, beyond the postcard
home.heroText: Small-group journeys through the Mekong Delta, Angkor and Laos, led by local guides. Tell us your dates: a specialist replies within one business day.

why.d: 10 to 12 travellers on land tours, never a coach load.
Licensed French or English-speaking guides who live in the region.
No instant checkout: a specialist checks dates and answers within one business day.

forWho.d: Culture, food and comfort away from mass tourism.
Realistic pacing, short transfers, rest periods.
Clear inclusions and prices, easy mobile contact.

about.title: About
about.p1: Beyond the Mekong is a fictional boutique operator created as a demonstration by NeuraWeb. It shows how a small tour operator can present its journeys, collect qualified enquiries and follow them up.
about.p2: Itineraries on this site are based on real routes along the Mekong, from Ho Chi Minh City to Luang Prabang. Departures, enquiries and the admin area are simulated.
responsible: Ethical elephant sanctuaries only, no riding
Respectful behaviour at temples and in villages
about.legal: A real operator would display here its legal identity, financial guarantee and insurance details (for example the Atout France registration for France-based operators). Not applicable to this demo.
about.imageAlt: A boat guide's hands on an oar on a Mekong Delta canal
